official: 羽村市税賦課徴収条例及び羽村市後期高齢者医療に関する条例の一部を改正する条例
name: 公示送達をネットでも閲覧可能に
summary: 地方税法等の改正に伴い、市税と後期高齢者医療に関する2つの条例を改正します。公示送達の内容をインターネットで閲覧できるようにし、市の事務所でも書面の掲示または電子画面で閲覧できる措置を取ります。
changes: 公示事項をインターネットで閲覧できる状態にする
事務所で書面の掲示または電子画面による閲覧措置を取る
why: 地方税法等の一部を改正する法律の施行に伴う改正のためと、市は説明しています。

en.name: Makes public notices of service viewable online
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Hamura City Tax Assessment and Collection Ordinance and the Hamura City Ordinance on Medical Care for Older Senior Citizens
en.summary: Following amendments to the Local Tax Act and other laws, the city will amend two ordinances concerning city taxes and medical care for older senior citizens. The city will make the contents of public notices of service viewable on the internet, and will provide access at city offices by posting paper notices or displaying them on electronic screens.
changes: Make information in public notices of service viewable on the internet
Provide access at city offices by posting paper notices or displaying them on electronic screens
who: People who receive service by public notice
en.why: The city says the amendments are being made in connection with the enforcement of the Act Partially Amending the Local Tax Act and Other Laws.
